plugins.name: motta-statusline
plugins.description: Two-line status line: folder, repo link, git state, the branch's PR with CI, conflicts and review (toasts when they change), model and effort, context, rate limits, tokens and the generation rate. Under the prompt in the CLI, or as a band above it.

plugins.name: replay-theater
plugins.description: Step through the file edits Claude made in the last turn, one diff at a time. Vendored from anthropics/claude-code-playground@569c528 (Apache-2.0); opened with /replay only, no band hint.

plugins.name: filetree
plugins.description: IDE-style file tree with git status that shimmers on files Claude reads and writes. Third-party (MIT), pinned to the reviewed commit.

plugins.name: savvy-progress
plugins.description: Live agents panel (/agents-info) with each subagent's model, context, cost and time. Third-party (MIT), pinned to the reviewed commit.
